issues.summary: REM_COMMENT body-optional broadening introduced regression: `REM:`, `REM.`, `REM(` now mis-tokenize as comments because the bare-REM tie with IDENTIFIER lets REM_COMMENT win on declaration order.
issues.fix: Added `@lexer::members` action defining `IsRemBoundary()` (peeks via `InputStream.LA(1)` for CR/LF/EOF) and gated REM_COMMENT with `{IsRemBoundary()}?` semantic predicate. Added Theory test `RemKeyword_FollowedByNonBoundary_IsNotComment` covering `REM:`, `REM.`, `REM(`. Existing `Identifier_RemediatePrefixed_IsIdentifierNotComment`, `RemKeyword_AtBareEol_IsHiddenComment`, `RemKeyword_AtEof_IsHiddenComment` continue to pass.
